_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pelican-eggs/games-standalone (MIT).
name: CrewLink
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The voice relay server for CrewLink and BetterCrewLink, the proximity voice chat for Among Us. Players set its address as the voice server in their client.
startup: a="{{ADDRESS}}"; if [ -z "$a" ]; then a=$(curl -fsS4 --max-time 5 https://api.ipify.org || true); echo "Public address: ${a:-not found}"; fi; export PORT={{SERVER_PORT}} ADDRESS="$a" HOSTNAME="$a" NAME="{{NAME}}"; exec node dist/index.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# CrewLink. Clones the voice relay server for CrewLink or BetterCrewLink
# from GitHub (or updates it), installs its packages and builds it. Files
# the repository doesn't track (certificates, config/peerConfig.yml) are
# never touched.
set -euo pipefail
export npm_config_update_notifier=false
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "${SERVER_SOFTWARE:-bettercrewlink}" in
bettercrewlink) repo=https://github.com/OhMyGuus/BetterCrewlink-server.git name=BetterCrewLink ;;
crewlink) repo=https://github.com/ottomated/crewlink-server.git name=CrewLink ;;
*) fail "Server must be bettercrewlink or crewlink." ;;
esac
git() { command git -c safe.directory=/mnt/server -c advice.detachedHead=false "$@"; }
ref="${BRANCH:-HEAD}"

if [ -d .git ]; then
    echo "Updating the $name server"
    git remote set-url origin "$repo"
    git fetch -q --depth 1 origin "$ref" || fail "GitHub has no branch $ref for the $name server, or can't be reached right now."
    git reset -q --hard FETCH_HEAD
elif [ -n "$(ls -A)" ]; then
    fail "The folder already has files and isn't a Git repository, so nothing was cloned. Empty it, then reinstall."
else
    echo "Downloading the $name server"
    git init -q .
    git remote add origin "$repo"
    git fetch -q --depth 1 origin "$ref" || fail "GitHub has no branch $ref for the $name server, or can't be reached right now."
    git reset -q --hard FETCH_HEAD
fi

echo "Installing packages and building"
rm -rf dist node_modules
npm install --no-fund --no-audit --loglevel=error
npx --no-install tsc
[ -f dist/index.js ] || fail "The build made no dist/index.js."
echo "Installed the $name server ($(git rev-parse --short HEAD))."

variables.name: Server
variables.description: bettercrewlink for BetterCrewLink clients, or crewlink for the original CrewLink.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name the server reports to clients.

variables.name: Address
variables.description: The domain or IP address players connect to. Empty finds the server's public IPv4 address at every start.

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description: The branch to install. Empty uses the repository's default branch.

variables.name: HTTPS
variables.description: Serve over https: put privkey.pem and fullchain.pem in the server's folder. Empty serves plain http (set it to true for https).

variables.name: Certificate folder
variables.description: Another folder to read the https certificates from.
